_usage: Bodies for PATCH /api/me/flows/{id}/canary (scope flows:publish). Pick ONE of the three below — send its value as the whole request body.

allowlist_owner_first._when: Right after first publish: only these phones reach the new flow. Start with the business owner's own number.

percent_gradual._when: Gradual rollout: this % of contacts get the flow, sticky per contact per day. Raise 10 -> 50 -> clear.

clear_full_traffic._when: Remove the canary entirely -> 100% of the flow's audience is served. Send an EMPTY body: {}
